Lotto America Results

You could be a jackpot winner, right now! Here's where you can find the latest Lotto America results.

The Lotto America draw is held every Monday, Wednesday and Saturday. Are you holding the lucky ticket? It's time to find out.

Are you a winner?

To bring home the jackpot, you will need to match all five main numbers plus the Star Ball.

If you haven't matched all the numbers, you may still have won a prize. Even if you only match the Star Ball you still win a prize!

We'll let you know via email if you have won a prize in the Lotto America lottery draw.

Draws are conducted every Wednesday and Saturday.
